envelope.description: Pin the library's behaviour after its locks are removed, as a two-process test

body.title: Pin the library's behaviour after its locks are removed, as a two-process test
body.summary: Build the child-process helper (opens a store at a given path, optionally declares, reports over standard output) and the reproduction test against the real library on a temporary store: process A opens and writes, A opens and closes a second descriptor on the lock file, process B opens, writes and closes; then in A a read throws code -30775, a synchronous transaction throws code 22, and an asynchronous transaction has not settled after 3 seconds. Every child is ended by a kill from the test, since a broken process never exits by itself.
acceptanceChecks: The test passes on the bundled library and asserts the three behaviours separately
Without the second descriptor being opened and closed in A, the same sequence leaves A's write working
No child process is left running after the test file ends, also when an assertion fails

tests.name: reproduction against the real library: read throws -30775, synchronous transaction throws 22, asynchronous transaction does not settle
control case: without the second descriptor, the other process's close leaves the first process's write working
